product.title: Paris Private Guided Tour in a Vintage Car with Driver

description.text: If you're celebrating a special occasion and want to see the sights of Paris with a dash of classic charm, few experiences top this private sightseeing adventure where you glide through the city in an open-roof Citroen. You can hop into the car after easy pickup and let your guide chauffeur you through the City of Light, offering helpful narration as you go. Stops include Montmartre, Latin Quarter, Moulin Rouge, Champs-Élysées, Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum. Explore charming neighborhoods like Montmartre and the Latin Quarter, see top sights like the Moulin Rouge, and cruise down the elegant Champs-Elysées. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own.
